candidates.change_summary: Replace the body of owner() to return a constant address instead of storage variable, changing observable return value.
Return the negation of the current paused state instead of the actual paused state.
Change the default royaltyBPS from 500 to 1000 when no specific royalties are configured for the tokenId
Change default royaltyRecipient to address(0) instead of the stored royaltyRecipient when returning the default configuration
Remove the condition that checks for a configured royalty recipient, always returning the default configuration
Return a configuration with zero royaltyBPS instead of the default 500 when token-specific config is missing.
Return a configuration with a different default royaltyRecipient (address(0) instead of the stored default recipient).
Remove the check for token-specific royalty configuration, always return the default configuration.
